title.note: Game title is a brand; glossary decision keep, no Malay title supplied.

hud.cast.note: 'lontar' is the angler's word for a cast (a cast = 'lontaran'); plain 'Baling' (throw) also works. Not 'Buang' (throw away).

hud.reel.note: 'pull (the line in)'; same verb as the pass name Tarik Auto. Angler slang 'karau' is less known to kids.

hud.bait_left.note: Malay nouns never change after a number, so this is right for 0, 1 and more (guide: '{count} Syiling').

catch.success.note: Malay puts the modifier after the noun, so {rarity} follows {fish} ('Ikan Kap Emas Nadir', like the guide's 'Naga Legenda'); no agreement or article to break.

catch.escaped.note: 'That fish slipped loose...'; names the fish generically because 'Ia terlepas' reads stiff for an object.

catch.new_record.note: DBP spelling 'baharu'; 'kg' unchanged and Malaysia uses the decimal point, so '12.4' reads right.

fish.golden_carp.note: 'ikan kap' = carp (as in 'kap rumput', grass carp). 'Ikan Emas' alone means goldfish in Malaysia, so 'Kap' keeps it a carp; 'Ikan' kept so 'Kap' is not read as lampshade or stamp.

fish.lantern_eel.note: 'belut' = eel; 'tanglung' is the Malaysian word for a glowing lantern (Pesta Tanglung), keeping the glowing-lantern idea. 'Belut Pelita' (oil lamp) is the alternative.

rarity.mythic.note: Noun tier label, parallel to 'Legenda' (guide's Legendary). Malaysian kids know Legend < Mythic from Mobile Legends ranks, so it reads as the higher tier; a native should confirm.

shop.rods.note: 'joran' = fishing rod (batang pancing); never 'rod' or 'batang' alone.

shop.equip.note: 'Use' is how Malay game UI says equip for a tool; literal 'Lengkapkan' is stiff.

shop.equipped.note: State label 'in use', the passive of the 'Guna' button.

shop.buy_robux.note: Guide pattern: the colon stops it reading as 'buy {price} Robux'.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as the Tarik button; 'auto' follows the noun as in Malaysian 'kereta auto'. 'Tarik Automatik' is 15 of 14. Store name in Creator Hub should match.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Umpan Bertuah menggandakan peluang anda menangkap ikan nadir!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Rare = 'nadir' (Kamus Dewan: seldom found; 'spesies nadir'), used for both the tier and 'rare fish'. 'Jarang' is commoner but 'ikan jarang' reads as 'sparse fish'; Indonesian 'langka' avoided. Native check on 'nadir' for kids.

sell.done.text: Anda menjual {count} ikan dan dapat {coins} syiling!
sell.done.note: 'You sold {count} fish and got {coins} coins!'; Malay nouns do not change for 1, and 'untuk' for a price would be a calque. 38 of 40.

sell.prompt.note: 21 of 21, same pattern as the guide's 'Tekan E untuk membuka'.

ascend.button.note: 'Rise up', the everyday sense (as in 'bangkit semula'), not religious or climbing. 'Naik Darjat' (rise in status) is more exact but 11 of 10.

ascend.confirm.text: Bangkit sekarang? Anda akan mula semula, tetapi akan menangkap ikan nadir {bonus}% lebih kerap.
ascend.confirm.note: Short question without 'Adakah' per the guide; 'mula semula' = start over; percent with no space.

weather.storm.text: Ribut akan melanda! Ikan nadir sedang makan umpan.
weather.storm.note: 'A storm will strike!' is the natural Malay alarm; 'makan umpan' = take the bait (fishing sense of biting). 'ribut', not Indonesian 'badai'.

quest.catch_n.text: Tangkap {n} ikan di Teluk Cahaya Bulan
quest.catch_n.note: Moonlit Bay = 'Teluk Cahaya Bulan' (moonlight bay); 'Terang Bulan' avoided for its anthem association. 35 of 40.

trade.sent.note: 33 of 33. 'kepada' because {player} is a person; 'dihantar', not Indonesian 'dikirim'.

trade.accept.note: 'your trade' made 'your trade request', matching trade.sent.

codes.redeemed.text: Kod berjaya ditebus! Nikmati ganjaran anda.
codes.redeemed.note: 'berjaya ditebus' (successfully redeemed) is the usual Malay success-message pattern. 43 of 45.

afk.kicked.text: Anda terlalu lama tidak aktif dan berhenti memancing.

event.ends.note: Developer: {time} like '2d 4h' reads wrong in Malay, where 'h' means hari (days). Format it for ms-my as '2 h 4 j' (CLDR) or '2 hari 4 jam'.

daily.streak.text: Hari berturut-turut: {day}! Kembali esok untuk ganjaran lagi.
daily.streak.note: Label form 'Days in a row: {day}!' so day = 1 reads right; 'Hari ke-{day}' breaks at 1 (should be 'pertama'). 'Rentetan' (as in 'rentetan kemenangan') is the alternative for streak. 56 of 62.

tip.night.text: Petua: Sesetengah ikan hanya makan umpan pada waktu malam.
tip.night.note: 'Petua' is the Malaysian word for a tip or hint; 'makan umpan' = bite in the fishing sense. 58 of 60.

group.join.text: Sertai komuniti kami dan dapat 50 umpan percuma!
group.join.note: 'komuniti' per Roblox's Communities rename (guide); switch to 'kumpulan' if the game's own UI says group. 'kami' (our) added as Malay needs an owner for the community.

leaderboard.biggest.note: 'Heaviest Fish', since the board ranks by weight; 'Tangkapan Terberat' is 19 of 18.
